description: Main source file for a Flutter-based note management app, including app initialization, theme setup, note data model, service for CRUD operations with Supabase, and UI screens such as list, detail, and edit views.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model representing a note with id, title, content, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service class providing CRUD operations for notes stored in Supabase.

classes.name: NotesApp
classes.description: Root widget defining the MaterialApp and theme configuration.

classes.name: NotesListScreen
classes.description: Main screen displaying list of notes with search and navigation capabilities.

classes.name: NoteDetailScreen
classes.description: Screen showing detailed view of a single note with options to edit or delete.

classes.name: NoteEditScreen
classes.description: Screen for creating a new note or editing an existing one.

methods.name: main
methods.description: App entry point, initializes environment, connects to Supabase, and runs the app.

methods.name: Note.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor parsing JSON data into a Note object.

methods.name: Note.toJson
methods.description: Converts Note object into JSON format for storage or transmission.

methods.name: NoteService.fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches list of notes from Supabase, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: NoteService.getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: NoteService.createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note in the database.

methods.name: NoteService.updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID.
